blockingFindings.description: Direct V210 crouch and sit renders show both thighs and shorts remaining in front of the overskirt. The lilac hem folds beside and behind the knees instead of spanning the lap; Astra found no visible improvement from V209.
The V210 prone render retains overlapping front fabric folds beneath the hips, and both standing profiles retain a stepped front edge at mid-thigh.
A small gray patch remains on the viewer-right inner upper arm in arms-up; the render needs a close-up to distinguish exposed avatar from garment shading.
